breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that `pimpleFoam` alone is insufficient for a fluid-structure interaction problem. It resolved the inconsistency by specifying a dedicated solid solver (`solidDisplacementFoam`) and a coupling library (`solids4foam`) to handle the two-way FSI, which is the correct approach for this type of simulation.
